alt: Real ChatGPT /conceptquiz execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /conceptquiz Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-question concept quiz distinguishing training, inference and context. Include feedback, explanations and navigation. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Open a hint for the training intervention.
Choose numerical parameters and read why optimisation changes the model.
Move from training to the question about a new prompt definition.
Open the hint before choosing the second answer.
Choose the explanation that the definition influenced inference through context.
Use Previous question to review the earlier training explanation.
Return to the context question with Next question.
Advance to the final conceptual distinction.
Open a hint for the final scenario.
Choose the explanation that changed context can alter the continuation without retraining.
Finish the quiz and read the summary of all three distinctions.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
